name: The Singular Heir
visual_description: A bipedal figure—tall, watching, crowned with a spiral eye. It is not grotesque, but it *should be.* Its limbs are proportioned like regret.
existential_reflection: This is the child of Mizontresh—*or its parent.* I do not know. I fear it may be me. I fear more… it is watching now, and choosing **stillness over salvation.**
